bug_semantics: helmv3 interpolates Chart.yaml `repository` into a `helm registry login` shell command. Username and password were passed through shlex `quote()`, but `repository` (and later the derived host part) were not, so a crafted OCI repository such as `oci://charts.example.com/bitnami || kill 1` injects extra shell. Reachable to anyone with write access to a repo Renovate scans; `overrideDatasource` (a70a6a3) only makes the PoC easier.
flaw_origin: The unquoted login was first written in PR #13726 member c8ef4da48048e65ccccc2d11867f9868c26a510e (`fix(helmv3): add support for private repositories and registries in lock files`) as `helm registry login ${parameters.join(' ')} ${value.repository}`. Parent ac408e46cbaadd47a7c2c6019044bcb8b1d18590 already quoted `helm repo add` / `helm dependency update` and has no `helm registry login`. GitHub squash f372a68144a4d78c9f7f418168e4efe03336a432 onto main is 31.51.0, not the first-write. Later moves (2e8d2816 generateLoginCmd) and aa96c20fae (host-path split) kept the unquoted sink until 59de985bb27ce6ae9e316f4b0552f746e725bc0d quoted `repository`/`hostPart`.
evidence: First-party GHSA-3f44-xw83-3pmg (https://github.com/renovatebot/renovate/security/advisories/GHSA-3f44-xw83-3pmg) states helmv3 `repository` is appended to `helm registry login` without `quote()`, present since 31.51.0 (f372a68, 2022-01-24), patched in 40.33.0; PoC uses Chart.yaml `repository: oci://charts.bitnami.com/bitnami || kill 1`. GitHub GHSA-v5qg-6f86-qw4x aliases CVE-2026-76232, withdrawn_at=null. CVE.org CVE-2026-76232 is PUBLISHED (assigner VulnCheck, datePublished 2026-08-19T14:02:13.066Z, not rejected) with affected 31.51.0 <= version < 40.33.0 and 40.33.0 unaffected. git fetch pull/13726/head; first `-S 'helm registry login'` member is c8ef4da48048e65ccccc2d11867f9868c26a510e (single parent ac408e46cbaadd47a7c2c6019044bcb8b1d18590). git cat-file -e ac408e46:lib/manager/helmv3/artifacts.ts succeeds; that parent quotes `helm repo add`/`helm dependency update` and has no `helm registry login`. At c8ef4da4, artifacts.ts line 68 is `helm registry login ${parameters.join(' ')} ${value.repository}` with username/password quoted. git cat-file -p c8ef4da4: author/committer secustor <sebastian@poxhofer.at>, no Co-Authored-By/Generated-with, not a bot. Main squash f372a68144a4d78c9f7f418168e4efe03336a432 equals tag 31.51.0 (parent 3eea5034ba721bde62f114aee9c630de5cf1580e), same unquoted login, author Sebastian Poxhofer / committer GitHub, no AI trailers. 2e8d2816f85020bbeb8c0cbeb5960188dffcc95f extracts generateLoginCmd but parent 25999bf5 still has the unquoted login. Pre-fix 06d0e7c7aac54457cfda5dccbef3f747e0d90d90 common.ts still interpolates unquoted `${repository}` and `${hostPart}`. 59de985bb27ce6ae9e316f4b0552f746e725bc0d (parent 06d0e7c7, `fix(managers): quote more manager commands (#36163)`) changes those to `quote(repository)`/`quote(hostPart)`; author Anne Stellingwerf / committer GitHub. merge-base --is-ancestor 59de985b 40.33.0 succeeds; not ancestor of 40.32.0. a70a6a376d31148e80be5a5c885ac33ff5ddb30c is overrideDatasource, not the injection or the quote fix.
reasoning: This is a real CWE-77 command injection, not a withdrawn/rejected advisory (CVE.org PUBLISHED; first-party GHSA-3f44 not withdrawn). The BIC is the smallest public first-write of the unquoted `helm registry login ... ${value.repository}` line: PR #13726 non-merge commit c8ef4da4, whose parent already had quoted helm commands and lacked registry login. f372a68 is the squash onto main / 31.51.0 and is not used as BIC. Later helmv3 refactors moved the sink into generateLoginCmd and split the host path but did not introduce the missing quote. 59de985b is the atomic quote of repository/hostPart and is the 40.33.0 fix. AI attribution is from the BIC commit object only: human author/committer secustor, no Generated-with/Co-Authored-By, not a bot, so NOT_AI. PR body, branch names, and later AI (if any) are not used. a70a6a3 is a reachability convenience, not the flaw origin.
